source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Expired glucagon may have reduced effectiveness during a severe hypoglycemic emergency, when timely, effective treatment is critical","B":"Assuming the emergency kit requires fairly little further attention once it has first been obtained and stored away at home","C":"Believing that expiration dates matter mainly for insulin products, with fairly little relevance to a glucagon emergency kit itself","D":"Believing that glucagon, unlike most other medications, simply avoids carrying any kind of expiration date on its packaging"}}
source_row.rationale: Periodic expiration date checks for a glucagon emergency kit are important since expired glucagon may have reduced effectiveness, which could be critical during a severe hypoglycemic emergency requiring timely, effective treatment.
source_row.stem: A nurse teaches a client's family member to periodically check the expiration date of the household glucagon emergency kit. This is important because:
